name: Frantz Fanon
shortBio: Martinican psychiatrist, existential philosopher, and revolutionary theorist whose works established the foundations of post-colonial theory and the phenomenology of racial oppression.
centralQuestion: How does colonial subjugation disfigure human consciousness, and by what psychological and dialectical struggle can colonized subjects liberate their humanity?

keyWorks.title: Black Skin, White Masks
keyWorks.description: Existential psychoanalytic investigation into the psychic trauma, alienation, and internalization of racial inferiority under colonialism.

keyWorks.title: The Wretched of the Earth
keyWorks.description: Classic treatise on the dialectics of anti-colonial revolution, systemic violence, and the creation of a new humanist consciousness.
